status: Measurement record for the native placement rule. The rule is implemented in the converter (WorksheetMarkerPlacement in crates/office2pdf/src/render/typst_gen_diagrams.rs); candidate-marker-centers.json records the compiled PDF centers against these native controls.
geometry_provenance: After-export native chart getters for chart origin/plot inner bounds. Gift plot height from independently traced native major-grid top and zero-axis, because getter retains pre-export chart height. No parameters fitted to marker positions.
rule: Suppressed/automatic outline: nearest point; explicit zero: floor point. Positive explicit width: round half up with minimum one; odd result floors point, even result rounds point. Odd marker size then shifts center by minus half a sheet point. Canvas is size+2 for suppressed, size for explicit zero, else size+2*ceil((rounded_width+1)/2).
